To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a discrete time thermo electric model of a battery is proposed and the model is used to determine a pulse width control strategy to regulate the battery temperature.
the proposed battery model is capable to estimate the battery temperature and the pulse width control system is capable to maintain the battery temperature within safe limits.
a battery temperature model is proposed which is then used for fast charging control of the battery.
In summary, our research is concerned with

developing a temperature sensitive control strategy that can be implemented on a pulse charging battery system to ensure battery temperature safety while maintaining the battery SOC at a desired level.
developing an efficient and robust fast charging control system which can be implemented for electric vehicles.

the development of an accurate battery model which is capable of predicting the battery temperature in real-time and is then subjected to temperature based control methodology which regulates the pulse charging operation to ensure safe operation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a regulated pulse charging method can be used for fast charging without compromising battery temperature.
the proposed model and control scheme can be implemented to determine a safe charging current profile which maintains battery temperature within safe operating limits.
the proposed model can be used for the development of a temperature sensitive controller for pulse charging of traction batteries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the battery temperature estimation model can be used for a fast charging control system which would determine the pulse width for a given charging current magnitude and a desired battery temperature.
a fast charging system can be designed for a given battery pack with the aid of the proposed model and the temperature based control system.
a fast charging system can be designed to maintain battery temperature within the safe operating range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the battery temperature is a key parameter that should be considered in the fast charging process.
fast charging can be done in a safe manner if the pulse charging current magnitude is maintained within 0.5C and 2C.
the proposed model can be used to determine the charging current and pulse width to maintain battery temperature within safe limits.
